value.title: Package boomtick-cli and mcp server for standalone distribution
value.body:
Transitioned boomtick-pkg/cli into a standard, distributable Python package and @boomtick/mcp into a standalone Node package. 

Key changes:
1.  **Resource Bundling**: Moved static assets (review templates, guidelines, prompts) into `dev_tools/resources` and updated the Python code to use `importlib.resources`. This allows the CLI to find its required files regardless of where it is installed.
2.  **Workspace Logging**: Redirected all logs and temporary audit files to `.boomtick/logs/` in the current working directory, ensuring the package directory remains read-only after installation.
3.  **MCP Decoupling**: Updated the MCP server to call the global `td-cli` command. Removed hardcoded relative paths and `PYTHONPATH` mutations in favor of standard module resolution and system-wide binary access.
4.  **Editable Install Support**: Verified the changes by installing the CLI in editable mode and running it from external directories.
5.  **Test Maintenance**: Updated unit tests that relied on hardcoded paths to use the new resource resolution logic.

Note: One MCP test (`github.create_issue.test.ts`) failed due to a missing `contract.ts` file in the source tree, which appears to be a pre-existing issue unrelated to the packaging changes. All 77 Python CLI tests passed successfully.

Fixes #3476

value.title: Fix search modal missing auto-focus
value.body:
When a user opens the search modal, the text input element now automatically receives focus, allowing for immediate typing. This is achieved via a `useEffect` hook in `GlobalSearch.tsx` that triggers `inputRef.current?.focus()` within a `requestAnimationFrame` when the `isOpen` state becomes true. A corresponding E2E test has been added to `tests/search.spec.ts` to ensure this behavior is maintained.

Fixes #3475

value.title: improve devai vis layout: Fix Visual Layout & Accessibility Hierarchy
value.body:
This submission addresses the UX Audit Ticket for fixing visual layout and accessibility hierarchy issues. Key improvements include better text legibility on hero cards via gradient overlays, standardization of sidebar card aspect ratios and padding, and global typographic enhancements for better readability (line-height and tracking). I also enforced a consistent 6px corner radius across all major card components and restricted article reading width to the recommended 65ch. All changes were verified visually and through automated tests.

Fixes #3265

value.title: Partial fix for mypy type-checking errors in Python codebase
value.body:
I have addressed a significant number of mypy type-checking errors in `boomtick-pkg/cli/dev_tools/orchestrator.py`. Key changes include adding type guards for command execution results, resolving variable shadowing that led to type conflicts, and adding explicit type annotations to help mypy narrow down types. While I have made substantial progress on the primary file identified, there are still remaining errors in other parts of the codebase (`daemon.py`, `cli.py`, and tests) that need to be addressed to fully satisfy the acceptance criteria.

Fixes #3377
